tasks.task: I need to prepare an end-of-day status update for the Northwind Logistics — PMO workspace. By 5pm today, confirm whether the PAY Kanban board (in Jira at https://latticeworks.atlassian.net) currently has any open (not Done) issues, and include the project lead’s display name. Use the live Jira data (refresh), not just cached results.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one board and includes a board named "PAY Kanban" with id 84 (a valid non-empty identifier).

Step 1 returns search results showing the total count of issues where statusCategory != Done for project PAY (expected to be 0 based on provided sample response, but must be read from the refreshed tool output).
Step 2 returns a Jira user profile for accountId "5e9d1b0c4f3a9c0a1b2c3d4e" with displayName "Nina Patel" (or whatever live Jira returns after refresh).

args.jql: project = PAY and statusCategory != Done order by updated DESC

tasks.task: I’m preparing today’s (by 5pm) PAY status report for the “Payments Platform” Jira project in workspace “Northwind Logistics — PMO”. Please (1) confirm which agile board is associated with project PAY, (2) pull the latest list of open (not Done) PAY issues with key/summary/status/updated, and (3) spot-check the project lead user profile (Nina Patel, accountId 5e9d1b0c4f3a9c0a1b2c3d4e) to ensure we have the right owner on record. Use the existing Jira cloud connection in that workspace and refresh data where possible.

success_criteria: Step 0 returns at least one board and includes a board whose location.projectKey is "PAY" (e.g., "PAY Kanban").
Step 1 executes successfully using the projectKey derived from Step 0 and returns a JSON payload with data.issues (may be empty) and includes requested fields (key, summary, status, updated).
Step 2 returns a Jira user profile for accountId "5e9d1b0c4f3a9c0a1b2c3d4e" with displayName "Nina Patel" (or the equivalent name field) after refresh.

args.jql: project = $0.boards.0.location.projectKey and statusCategory != Done order by updated DESC
